custom_ops.description: Baseline short class name to qualified replacement class; all registered ops, even unused.
custom_ops.title: Custom Ops

device.description: Profile selected before upstream mocks are imported.
device.title: Device

patched.description: Qualified patched symbol to repo-relative origin file; runtime identity diff is authoritative.
patched.title: Patched

profile.description: Declarative hardware profile and sorted capability names.
profile.title: Profile

ascend.description: Observed replacement, absent/null if class identity did not change.

attrs.description: Whitelisted observed attributes; partition/head attrs are per-rank facts, constructor input_size/output_size can be global. Lower normalizes GLOBAL rule context, never divides local attrs twice.
attrs.title: Attrs

class.description: Baseline fully qualified class; keep even when Ascend replacement is present.
class.title: Class

params.description: Direct parameters only, sorted by local name; do not recursively double count.
params.title: Params

path.description: named_modules path, empty string for root; modules sorted lexically by path.
path.title: Path

src.description: Baseline declaration; null only for external containers such as torch ModuleList.

class.description: Actual Ascend class after CustomOp registration.
class.title: Class

src.description: Actual replacement declaration from immutable source.

ep.description: vLLM enable_expert_parallel flag. IR ep is an integer degree; see DSL spec.
ep.title: Ep

rank.description: Global construction rank; fixtures use rank zero.
rank.title: Rank

tp.description: Meta construction TP world size, not a runtime expression.
tp.title: Tp

dtype.description: Observed torch dtype normalized without torch. prefix, e.g. bfloat16.
dtype.title: Dtype

name.description: Local parameter name, e.g. weight or w13_weight, not a full module path.
name.title: Name

shape.description: Observed local-rank meta parameter dimensions, ordinary nonnegative integers.
shape.title: Shape

config_rev.description: HF commit SHA or inline:sha256:<canonical-config-hash>; no weights revision.
config_rev.title: Config Rev

hf_id.description: Hugging Face repository identifier, e.g. Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B.
hf_id.title: Hf Id

commit.description: Full immutable Git commit SHA, never an abbreviated hash.
commit.title: Commit

tag.description: Release tag or main; display only, identity is commit.
tag.title: Tag

ascend.description: Paired vllm-ascend revision, including for the baseline graph.

device.description: Selected hardware profile; H100 is a reference profile.
device.title: Device

generator_version.description: Generator package version; no generation timestamp.
generator_version.title: Generator Version

model.description: Model identity plus immutable configuration identity.

vllm.description: Paired vLLM revision resolved before extraction.

commit.description: Full source commit; vllm/ascend must agree with Snapshot.
commit.title: Commit

file.description: Repository-relative POSIX path, without a URL or line fragment.
file.title: File

line.description: One-based class/def declaration line found by AST/inspect, never agent-authored.
line.title: Line

repo.description: Source repository, used to construct immutable links.
repo.title: Repo

symbol.description: Qualified class/function symbol resolved by the extraction script.
symbol.title: Symbol

ascend.description: CPU/mock-derived overlay facts, not measured NPU behavior.

config.description: Full pinned HF config contents, no model weights.
config.title: Config

env.description: Version strings only, e.g. python/torch; no host paths or timestamps.
env.title: Env

fixture.description: True for curated partial examples; false for production extraction.
fixture.title: Fixture

layer_types.description: One layer type per decoder layer in original execution order.
layer_types.title: Layer Types

modules.description: Flat module tree in lexical path order; fixtures may include only layer zero.
modules.title: Modules
